running_row_reconciliation.method: ledger RUNNING rows matched against a live ps snapshot: first by the attempt id appearing in a process cmdline, then (single-owner runs) by process start time within the window; unmatched rows are ORPHAN_NO_LIVE_PROCESS

evidence.match: no live process carries this attempt id or its start time

rows.action: supervisor recover_interrupted under the run lock (charges the reservation); RA-01 does not mutate the ledger
